strings.name: Sue Bird
strings.role: Basketball player · USA women's team executive
strings.summary: Bird's control, passing and judgment made her a long-serving Seattle Storm leader, winning four WNBA championships and five consecutive Olympic golds with the United States. Developed at Connecticut, she also played for Russian clubs. After retiring in 2022 she remained active in investment and women's basketball media. In 2025 she became USA Basketball's first women's managing director; she worked as an executive during the team's 2026 World Cup title campaign.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 16, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: WNBA and repeated Olympic championships helped expand women's professional basketball's sporting and public influence.

strings.timeline.t7.title: League and Olympic gold
